assumptions.statement: Rooms without a size from you use typical sizes for a first layout: Entrance hall 6 m², Living room 25 m², Kitchen 12 m², Dining 14 m², Main bedroom 15 m², Child's bedroom 1 11 m², Child's bedroom 2 11 m², En-suite bathroom 5 m², Bathroom 1 6 m², Plant / technical room 4 m², Stair 10 m². These are not building-code minimums; no local rules are loaded.

assumptions.basis: Typical share for a compact house; checked again in Milestone D.
assumptions.statement: Halls, walls and structure add 20% to the room areas.

assumptions.basis: Every house needs a way in and room for heating, water and electrics.
assumptions.statement: The house has an entrance hall and a small plant / technical room.

assumptions.basis: Who sleeps where, from the household answers.
assumptions.statement: The main bedroom is tested for a double bed and children's bedrooms for single beds.
